title: Extend OPCPFluidArray with TUAS-FluidArray-like interface (lateral coupling, heat source, geometry, flow bookkeeping)
description:
Give OPCPFluidArray (rhoPimpleFoam/mod.rs) a subset of tuas_boussinesq_solver's
FluidArray interface, so a future TAMPINES Pipe component can enum-dispatch
between a TUAS backend and a coolprop backend interchangeably. Scope
(confirmed with user via plan-mode session 2026-07-13, see
outram-park-dt-plan.md at workspace root and the full planning-tool record):

- New fields: lateral_adjacent_array_temperature_vector/conductance_vector
  (Vec<Vec<T>>, not Array1 -- coolprop has no ndarray dep), q_vector/
  q_fraction_vector (heat source), wetted_perimeter, incline_angle,
  mass_flowrate, pressure_loss, internal_pressure_source.
- Simplified vs TUAS: no NusseltCorrelation or DimensionlessDarcyLossCorrelations
  port -- caller supplies conductance/pressure-loss values directly.
- Lateral coupling + heat source wired into step()'s energy equation now
  (one-line addition to the existing explicit source-term loop, alongside
  conv_he/dp_dt). Geometry/flow-bookkeeping fields stay pure bookkeeping,
  not read by step() (matches TUAS itself).
- New error type OPCPFluidArrayError::LengthMismatch (own type, not a
  MeshError reuse), properly re-exported from lib.rs (fixes the existing
  MeshError-not-exported gap in the same pass).
- New file rhoPimpleFoam/lateral_coupling.rs (mirrors TUAS's own
  directory-per-concern split for this exact feature) -- 13 new methods,
  7 new tests.
- set_temperature_vector needs a real per-cell (p,T) flash + write
  he/rho/t/psi together, NOT a plain t field write (he is the actual PIMPLE
  state variable; a plain t write would be silently undone by the next
  correct_thermo() call).

This is Part 1 of a 3-part plan (Part 2: new tampines crate, Part 3: new
outram-park-digital-twin-gui crate) -- this bead covers Part 1 only.
notes: Done 2026-07-13: lateral_coupling.rs created (13 methods, 7 tests), new() field initializers added, step() wires lateral conductance + heat source into the energy-equation source term (extensive Watts, matching conv_he/dp_dt units), clear_vectors() called at end of step(). OPCPFluidArrayError re-exported from lib.rs. Test fix: test fluid changed from Water (liquid at 300K/1bar -- unreachable by the vapor-branch flash, silently no-ops every correct_thermo/state_pt call) to Nitrogen (matches existing passing tests' fluid choice). Also found t/rho lag he by one outer-corrector iteration in this PIMPLE solver -- tests call correct_thermo() after step() to sync t before reading temperature. Verified: cargo build --release clean, cargo test --release 248 lib tests passed (241 existing + 7 new) + all integration tests green, cargo check --workspace --lib --tests --release clean (no downstream breakage).

description: Port HumidAirProp.cpp: virial coeffs (Baa/Caaa/Bww/Cwww/Baw/Caaw/Caww), enhancement factor f(T,p), psychrometric outputs (W, RH, wet-bulb, dew point, moist-air h/s/rho per kg dry air), inverse solves. Verified vs ASHRAE psychrometric c_p/v to <0.1% (tests/humid_air_reference.rs). Found+fixed a real bug during verification: c_aaw was missing a /rhobarstar^2=1e6 factor (CoolProp source has TWO separate /1e6 divisions for that specific correlation, unlike its sibling c_aww), which had made the third-virial correction 4 orders of magnitude too large (5.5% V error before fix, <0.1% after). Wet-bulb + dew-point IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-13 (entropy remains open).

dew_point_temperature: ported CoolProp's DewpointTemperature secant solve
almost verbatim, seeded via this crate's own vle::saturation_temperature
(IAPWS-95) in place of IF97 Tsat97. Verified: T=30C/RH=50% -> Tdp=18.451C
(matches the well-known ~18.4C psychrometric-chart value).

wet_bulb_temperature: ported CoolProp's WetBulbSolver energy-balance
residual (LHS-RHS), root-found by bisection on [T_dp, T] instead of
CoolProp's Brent-with-fallback-bracket logic -- T_wb always lies in
[T_dp, T] (standard psychrometric fact), which sidesteps needing
CoolProp's own T_sat-adjacent bracket-clamping special case entirely
(its upstream comments cite real historical bugs #2255/#2690 about that).

Caught and fixed a real bug during verification: the first implementation
evaluated liquid water's enthalpy via flash::state_pt, which only reaches
the vapour/supercritical branch (documented in its own doc comment) --
wrong branch for the subcooled liquid water present at a typical T_wb. It
silently returned a nonsense enthalpy (~-4.2e22 J/kg for liquid water at
20C/1atm) instead of erroring. Fixed by using the saturated-liquid density
at T_wb (vle::saturation_at_temperature) instead, since liquid enthalpy is
only weakly pressure-dependent -- reuses the same pattern
saturation::vbar_ws already relies on elsewhere in this module.

Verified in tests/humid_air_reference.rs: (1) exact saturation identity
T_dp=T_wb=T at R=1 (rigorous, not approximate); (2) cross-check against
Stull (2011) J.Appl.Meteor.Climatol. 50:2267-2269's independent empirical
wet-bulb formula, <0.5C (30C/50%RH: 22.00C vs Stull 22.30C; 25C/60%RH:
19.47C vs Stull 19.50C). All 6 tests in that file pass; full crate suite
(240+ tests across all files) still passes; docs/api.md regenerated.

Remaining: entropy S still needs the ideal-gas reference-state offset
calibration (separate porting effort); T_wb/T_dp still output-only, not
yet supported as input keys.
Entropy S + T_wb/T_dp as input keys IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-13.

T_wb/T_dp as inputs: psi_w_from_dew_point (exact, non-iterative -- the dew
point IS the definition) and psi_w_from_wet_bulb (bisection parameterised
by trial dew point, reusing the already-verified forward wet_bulb_temperature
as the inner black-box). Needed a targeted fix for the exact-saturation
edge case (T_wb=T at R=1): the general bisection bracket degenerates there,
and the forward solve's own secant noise (~1e-7 K) can land T_wb on either
side of T, tripping an over-tight 1e-9 K bounds check. Fixed with a direct
psi_w = psi_ws(T,p) short-circuit + loosened bounds tolerance to 1e-4 K.
Verified via round-trip (T,p,R)->T_dp/T_wb->(T,p,T_dp/T_wb)->R, <1e-4,
including the R=1 edge case.

Entropy: NOT a port of CoolProp's own ensure_ref_offsets/calc_ideal_gas_alpha0
machinery (which needs the real ideal-gas Helmholtz term + a historical
multi-point calibration) -- CoolProp's own C++ literally prints "Not
implemented" for entropy in the simplified-polynomial-enthalpy branch this
crate already uses for H, so there's no CoolProp reference implementation
to port in this configuration at all. Instead: derived via Gibbs' theorem
(pure-component ideal-gas entropies at the mixture's total T,p, Cp(T) from
the SAME polynomials already verified for H) + the standard virial/mixing
corrections, anchored to an explicit ASHRAE zero-point convention (dry air
S=0 at 0C/1atm; water's constant derived via Clausius-Clapeyron from H's
own existing 0C anchor, confirmed consistent: h_w(0C)=2501 kJ/kg matches
the known latent heat of vaporization to 3 figures, now a permanent unit
test in mod.rs).

Caught a real bug during verification: first version used dry air's own
virial-corrected molar volume (+R*ln(v_a/v_a0)) mirroring CoolProp's own
volume-based formula -- but CoolProp's version evaluates the REAL ideal-gas
Helmholtz term there (density-native), while this port integrates Cp (the
CONSTANT-PRESSURE heat capacity), so the volume form silently smuggled in
a second, spurious T-dependence (v_a is proportional to T at fixed p),
breaking dS/dT=Cp/T by ~28% at 25C. Fixed by using -R*ln(p/p0) (total
pressure, Gibbs' theorem) for both air and water instead.

Verified: dS/dT=Cp/T (rigorous, model-independent thermodynamic identity)
holds to 7e-4 to 1.2e-3 across T=1-40C, W=0-0.02 kg/kg -- small, smooth,
and of the same order as the virial correction's own size (consistent with
a residual virial-cross-term path-dependence artifact, not a remaining bug).
CAVEAT, documented in the module doc: S's absolute value is NOT verified
against CoolProp or an external table (different reference-state convention
than CoolProp's own, and H's own mixture value already has a known ~6.6
kJ/kg ASHRAE offset that S likely inherits) -- only the temperature
dependence is rigorously verified. Full crate suite (241+ lib tests, 10 in
humid_air_reference.rs) passes; docs/api.md regenerated.

Remaining open in this bead: absolute-value cross-check for S against a
real external reference, if/when op-kbc.3 (rfluids oracle) lands.
